title: Liked it!
text: The story and sites were fun. I liked that you could choose to do the quest with or without a timer. Just make sure, before you start your quest, that you give the app access to your location in the settings on your phone.
author: darcys321

title: Fun few hours
text: Great quest! Took longer than suggested but we had fun! Took a while to work out how to get the quest but we got there in the end.
author: Lizzy A

title: Fun and educational at the same time
text:
Questo is a good alternative when you can’t find or want to go on a free walking tour. We used it on two occasions in two different cities and were positively impressed both times. The stories and puzzles are written by locals, vetted by peers and so far they didn’t disappoint. 

The Questo hotline is also super friendly and responsive when we had a small issue with a voucher.
author: DaBietjaaa

title: Fun way to experience the city
text: It was fun. A different way to discover the city's wonders and nooks if you don't need much history. The plot of the story could be more thought-through but still we enjoyed it.
author: 392jan_

title: Discovering Seville as a family
text: The game is a great way to motivate our five year old kid to walk around and explore the city. Would recommend
author: 01Hana01

title: Made touring around Seville exciting
text:
Story was great, made it very interesting. Learning about Seville while walking through the narrow streets.
Just a bit more walking than i expected. Maybe 20%.
author: jayG1954

title: Roam the streets of Seville
text: Finding places that we would never find on our own. Discovering little known nooks and crannies in the twisty streets of Seville.
author: Jay_G

title: Pleasant experience to discover Seville while having fun.
text: We had a great time, stress-free since time is not limited. Too bad the game is only in English.
